clm_acquisition_year_e389dc21.statement_hi: ठोईयां सहित 34 गांवों की भूमि 1984-85 में महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज के लिए अधिगृहीत की गई।
clm_acquisition_year_e389dc21.statement_en: Land of Thoiya and 33 other villages was acquired in 1984-85 for the Mahajan Field Firing Range.

evidence.text: करीब चार दशक पहले 34 गांवों को विस्थापित कर 3.37 लाख एकड़ के भूभाग में महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज को बनाया गया

clm_displacement_status_078f4074.statement_en: Residents of Thoiya were displaced and given compensation and resettlement land.

clm_village_list_34_18ca53da.statement_en: A community-shared list gives 32 of the 34 village names (unverified, single source)

evidence.text: 12 villages founded by Dhatarwals including Thoiya

clm_eponym_c4eb60ab.statement_en: The village is named after Thoili, daughter of Nathu Dhatarwal.

evidence.text: The village was founded after Thoili, the daughter of Nathu Dhatarwal. Thoili was married to Beniwals.

clm_clan_migration_origin_0aa2d0f9.statement_hi: नाथू धतरवाल अपने चाचा कालू धतरवाल और मामेरे भाई भिनयाराम रोज के साथ धाटी छोड़कर बादेरा में बस गए।
clm_clan_migration_origin_0aa2d0f9.statement_en: Nathu Dhatarwal, with his uncle Kalu Dhatarwal and maternal-cousin Bhinya Ram Roj, left Dhatri and settled at Baderan.

evidence.text: left Dhatri and settled at Baderan in Lunkaransar area where they constructed ponds and wells

evidence.text: drone frames 12-35 s: pond full of water, jaal trees on the bank
